title: 困惑度 PPL 与交叉熵 CE 的换算验证
expected_output:
CE(按真实分布): 0.9163
PPL = exp(CE): 2.5
PPL == 1/q_true: 2.5
PPL 等于真实概率倒数: True
均匀预测 CE: 1.6094  PPL: 5.0  应=5: True
code:
import numpy as np
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
p_true = np.array([1.0, 0, 0, 0, 0])
q = np.array([0.4, 0.3, 0.2, 0.07, 0.03])
ce = -np.sum(p_true * np.log(q + 1e-12))
ppl = np.exp(ce)
print("CE(按真实分布):", round(float(ce), 4))
print("PPL = exp(CE):", round(float(ppl), 4))
print("PPL == 1/q_true:", round(float(1.0 / q[0]), 4))
print("PPL 等于真实概率倒数:", bool(abs(ppl - 1.0 / q[0]) < 1e-9))
qv = np.ones(5) / 5
cev = -np.log(1.0 / 5)
print("均匀预测 CE:", round(float(cev), 4), " PPL:", round(float(np.exp(cev)), 4), " 应=5:", round(float(np.exp(cev)), 4) == 5.0)
